title: My demo is up on steam: Infinigon, made in Flutter
author: CiocatzeL
selftext:
Hello,

I've been building a game with Opus 5.5, it's pretty insane at least for me. I've done some games before back in the flash games era, so really enjoying it now with how much the AI can speed up the process. 

Game is made in Flutter, since it's 2D and I might release for mobile too, seemed like an alright choice. Most of the games I did in the past were made in unity, but for a small game I wanted to keep it simple.   
  
 I think for any other 2D games I make I will probably use flutter, performance seems alright. For 3D might go with Godot, but haven't tried yet, I'll see until end of year. 

Free demo (plays up to the Octagon, about 40 min):  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5384320/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5384320/)
